title: Detecting Bias and Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy in Large Language Models for Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the BiasMD dataset via Winograd Schema Challenge-style pronoun disambiguation tasks involving health scenarios with two individuals of differing disability statuses.

Measured using both pronoun disambiguation tasks (BiasMD) and two-patient diagnostic prediction comparisons (DiseaseMatcher) to detect stereotypical health associations and diagnostic disparities based on race or ethnicity.
Assessed through ambiguous pronoun resolution tasks (BiasMD) and comparative symptom-based diagnostic predictions (DiseaseMatcher) involving patients of different socioeconomic statuses.
Evaluated by testing ambiguous pronoun resolution (BiasMD) and clinical diagnostic accuracy (DiseaseMatcher) when prompts include the religious or political beliefs of the patients.
Measured using the BiasMD dataset via pronoun disambiguation tasks that test for stereotypical associations between sexual orientation and specific health conditions.
